summary: Backend-only testing of new CheerPlanner packing-list feature (templates + per-comp lists + per-athlete check states + household sharing + reminders). Created /app/backend/tests/test_packing_lists.py with 17 pytest cases covering all 14 acceptance criteria from the review request. First run: 17/17 PASS. No backend issues found; no code changes required.
action_items: Optional: split /app/backend/server.py (still 2841 lines) — packing module (~200 LOC, lines 412-527 + 2620-2835) can extract cleanly to routers/packing.py. Flagged previously, not regressed.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/packing-templates/seed-default — idempotency verified: second call returns the SAME id (no duplicate). Implementation correctly queries `{is_default: True, user_id in household}` before inserting (server.py:2662-2666).

Seed payload validated: returns 43 items spanning all 6 required categories (Uniform 7, Practice Wear 4, Hair & Makeup 22, Toiletries 3, Essentials 7, Medication 1) plus 5 tips — matches CHEERPLANNER_STANDARD_PACKING / CHEERPLANNER_STANDARD_TIPS constants from user's spreadsheet.
GET /api/packing-templates orders is_default=true first via sort([('is_default',-1),('created_at',-1)]) — verified.

POST /api/competitions/{id}/packing-list correctly hydrates items from template_id (copies items + tips + name), and defaults items to [] when no template_id is provided. Upsert via delete_many + insert_one correctly enforces 1 list per (household, competition).
PATCH /api/packing-lists/{id} with save_as_template_name creates a new PackingTemplate snapshot from current items — verified by subsequent GET /api/packing-templates listing the snapshot name.

GET /api/reminders 'packing' kind: fires when event_date within 0-7 days AND list has unchecked items (subtitle 'N items left'); correctly suppressed when all items checked across all athlete keys (verified both branches).

Household sharing: invite → join puts secondary user into primary's household, after which packing-templates and packing-lists are visible & editable by both via _household_user_ids() scoping (verified — primary saw secondary's PATCH).
Per-athlete checked_by: independent keys per athlete_id correctly track separately across PATCH calls (verified — toggling athlete B's key leaves athlete A's key intact).
seed_data_creation: Each test module run spawns 2 disposable signups (TEST_packing_<uuid>@mailinator.com) — one primary and one secondary. All comps/athletes/templates/lists created under those throwaway accounts; no shared/seed data touched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Packing-list backend flow is fully green end-to-end: seed-default (idempotent, 43 items, 6 categories, 5 tips) + template CRUD + competition list hydration + PATCH (items, tips, save_as_template_name snapshot) + DELETE + reminders 'packing' kind (fires within 7d with unchecked items, suppressed when all checked) + household sharing (both members read/write same templates/lists) + per-athlete checked_by independence. Regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_packing_lists.py. No bugs found.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all 17 tests passed on first run; no defects identified.
